purpose: Independent practice of C4 step 2 (data collection).
student_learning_goal: I can collect data to answer a math question about my town.

header.student_learning_goal_banner: I can collect data to answer a math question about my town.
header.character_watermark: Mayor Mira in the top-right corner. Small (~1.5in tall).

parts.student_instructions: Look at each town situation. Tally the count and record on the chart.
parts.visual_layout: Top of page. Four labelled tally rows.

image_placeholders.description: Four tally rows in B&W line-art, ~7in x 3in. Each row: situation label + visual + tally box + total slot. Pre-filled situations: 'Library books returned: 28', 'Buses arriving: 5', 'Sandwiches sold: 60', 'Recess minutes: 15'. Tally area below each. Header 'Town Tally:'.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image WS02_P1_TALLY: keywords (town, tally) name what the rows ask for.

parts.student_instructions: Use your data to answer 3 questions about town situations.
parts.visual_layout: Middle of page. Three numbered answer slots.

image_placeholders.description: Three numbered answer slots in B&W line-art, ~7in x 2.5in. Q1: 'How many TOTAL items in the data?'. Q2: 'Which is the BIGGEST count?'. Q3: 'Which is the SMALLEST count?'. Header 'Use Your Data:'.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image WS02_P2_USE: keywords (data) name what the slots ask for.

parts.student_instructions: Pick something to count in your real town life. Draw or describe. Tally. Write 1 question your data answers.
parts.visual_layout: Bottom of page. A blank data box with question line.

image_placeholders.description: A blank data box in B&W line-art, ~7in x 2.5in. 'My count: ___' on top. Tally area in the middle. 'My question: ___' at the bottom. Header 'My Real Town Data:'.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image WS02_P3_REAL: keywords (real, town) name what the box asks for.

parts.answer_key: Open. Child counts a real town thing and writes a question their count answers.

early_finisher_prompt: If you finish, count something else and add a tally row to Part 3.
teacher_notes: Lesson 2 worksheet practices C4 step 2. Watch for the guess-instead-of-count trap. Part 1 each row shows a visual cluster (14 book icons, 9 bus icons, etc.) the child must TALLY and total — the count is produced, not copied.
